skill_outcomes.skill_name: Basic and advanced concepts of knowledge management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and describe basic concepts and general knowledge about knowledge management in organizations and businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Main stages of knowledge management process
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and identify the main stages of the knowledge management process such as recognition, creation, acquisition, maintenance, sharing, and effective application of organizational knowledge.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Role of knowledge management in organizational activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the important role of knowledge management in the activities of organizations and businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Development process of knowledge management system
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply the development process of a knowledge management system to support operational, managerial, and administrative activities in organizations and businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analysis, design, operation, and management of knowledge management systems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Possess skills in analyzing, designing, operating, and managing knowledge management systems in organizations and businesses.
Possess the ability to independently seek information and read materials related to knowledge management.
Possess the ability to work independently or actively participate in group activities.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of management information systems.
